import datetime

token=''+access  # reuse from prior cell if exists
print('token ok', len(token))

# fetch approved sent payment requests, paginate
reqs=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    resp=apis.venmo.show_sent_payment_requests(access_token=token, status='approved', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    # resp could be dict or list; handle
    print('page',page_index,'type',type(resp))
    if not resp:
        break
    if isinstance(resp, dict) and 'payment_requests' in resp:
        page=resp['payment_requests']
    else:
        page=resp
    if not page:
        break
    print('  results',len(page))
    reqs.extend(page)
    page_index+=1
    if page_index>50:
        break

print('total approved sent requests',len(reqs))
# filter receiver name/email contains Brandon
cands=[r for r in reqs if ('brandon' in (r.get('receiver',{}).get('name','').lower()+r.get('receiver',{}).get('email','').lower()))]
print('cands',len(cands))
for r in sorted(cands, key=lambda x: (x.get('created_at') or '', x.get('updated_at') or ''), reverse=True)[:10]:
    print('id',r.get('payment_request_id'), 'amount',r.get('amount'), 'receiver',r.get('receiver',{}), 'created',r.get('created_at'), 'updated',r.get('updated_at'), 'approved',r.get('approved_at'))

pw=apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
venmo_pw=[p['password'] for p in pw if p['account_name']=='venmo'][0]
access=apis.venmo.login(username='pa_ritter@gmail.com', password=venmo_pw)['access_token']

# fetch all approved sent payment requests (paginate)
reqs=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    resp=apis.venmo.show_sent_payment_requests(access_token=access, status='approved', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not resp:
        break
    page=resp
    reqs.extend(page)
    page_index+=1
    if page_index>100:
        break

print('approved sent requests total',len(reqs))

# filter to Brandon by receiver name/email
brandon_reqs=[]
for r in reqs:
    recv=r.get('receiver',{})
    name=(recv.get('name') or '').lower()
    email=(recv.get('email') or '').lower()
    if 'brandon' in name or 'brandon' in email:
        brandon_reqs.append(r)
print('brandon approved sent requests',len(brandon_reqs))

# show candidates sorted by created_at desc

def to_dt(s):
    return s or ''

brandon_sorted=sorted(brandon_reqs, key=lambda x: x.get('created_at') or '', reverse=True)
for r in brandon_sorted[:10]:
    print('candidate id',r.get('payment_request_id'),'amount',r.get('amount'),'receiver',r.get('receiver'), 'created',r.get('created_at'),'updated',r.get('updated_at'),'approved',r.get('approved_at'))

last=brandon_sorted[0]
print('selected last id',last.get('payment_request_id'),'amount',last.get('amount'),'receiver_email',last.get('receiver',{}).get('email'))

# send money back to receiver_email
receiver_email=last.get('receiver',{}).get('email')
amount=float(last.get('amount'))
resp_send=apis.venmo.create_transaction(receiver_email=receiver_email, amount=amount, access_token=access, description='Returning money for an accidental Venmo payment request.')
print('send response',resp_send)
